items.title: 9.7.1 Calculating the pH of a buffer (buffer ka pH nikalna) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.7.1, printed pages 200-201, with Quick Check 9.4 as self-checks.

blocks.text: Ab dekhte hain ke definite (tay shuda) pH ka buffer kaise banta hai. Ek weak acid HA aur strong base (jaise NaOH) ke saath bana us ka salt NaA lein. HA aur NaA ke dissociation ke reversible reactions yeh hain:

blocks.text_alt: HA ⇌ H⁺ + A⁻; NaA ⇌ Na⁺ + A⁻

blocks.title: Interesting Information! (dilchasp maloomat!)
blocks.text: Jism ke khoon ka buffering system, jis mein bicarbonates shamil hain, khoon ka pH maintain (qaim) rakhne mein madad karta hai. (Kitab ka box adhoora chhapa hai.)
Buffer solution ka pH Henderson equation se nikalta hai:
Fraction ka numerator aur denominator aapas mein badal dein to log ka sign (nishan) badal jata hai:

Isi ko Henderson’s equation kehte hain. Is se pata chalta hai ke buffer ka pH do cheezon par depend karta hai: pehli, istemal hone wale acid ka pKa (pKa = −log Ka); doosri, salt aur acid ki concentrations ka ratio (tanasub). Sab se achha buffer salt aur acid ki barabar concentration le kar banta hai; tab pH acid ke pKa ke barabar hota hai. Example ke taur par acetic acid – sodium acetate buffer mein agar

blocks.text_alt: Then pH = pKa + log [CH₃COONa]/[CH₃COOH]; pH = pKa + log (1); So, pH = pKa + 0 = pKa; pH = 4.74

blocks.text: Yani is buffer ka pH bilkul acid ke pKa ke barabar hai.

blocks.caption: Buffer pH ki examples
rows: CH₃COOH 0.09 M / CH₃COONa 0.11 M, Ka 1.85 × 10⁻⁵ (Quick Check 9.4e)

blocks.prompt: a) Common ion effect ka solubility par kya asar hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Common ion solubility kam kar deta hai. Kam ghulne wale salt ke equilibrium mein jab us ka koi ion bahar se barha diya jaye to equilibrium ulti taraf chalta hai, aur salt kam ghulta hai ya precipitate ho jata hai; example: NaCl wale pani mein AgCl pure pani se bohat kam ghulta hai.

blocks.prompt: b) AgCl ke saturated solution mein kuch NaCl solution dala gaya. (i) Ag⁺ ki concentration par kya asar hoga? (ii) Common ion effect se explain karein.
blocks.explanation: (i) [Ag⁺] kam ho jati hai. (ii) Dala gaya Cl⁻ common ion hai. Equilibrium AgCl(s) ⇌ Ag⁺ + Cl⁻ baen taraf shift hota hai taake [Ag⁺][Cl⁻] = Ksp wahi rahe; is liye kuch AgCl precipitate hota hai aur [Ag⁺] gir jati hai.

blocks.prompt: c) Buffer pH ko kaise maintain (qaim) rakhta hai?
blocks.explanation: Buffer mein weak acid aur us ka conjugate base (salt se) dono kaafi amount mein hote hain. Dala gaya H⁺ conjugate base (jaise CH₃COO⁻) se mil kar weak acid ban jata hai, aur dala gaya OH⁻ weak acid se mil kar pani aur conjugate base bana deta hai. Is tarah dono kharch ho jate hain aur pH bohat kam badalta hai.

blocks.prompt: d) 0.50 M HF aur 0.45 M F⁻ wale buffer ka pH, 1.0 dm³ mein 0.40 g NaOH dalne se pehle aur baad, nikalein (HF ka Ka = 6.8 × 10⁻⁴).
e) 0.11 M CH₃COONa aur 0.09 M acetic acid wale buffer ka pH nikalein (Ka = 1.85 × 10⁻⁵).

items: Henderson’s equation: pH = pKa + log [Salt]/[Acid] (ya pH = pKa − log [Acid]/[Salt]).
Buffer ka pH acid ke pKa aur salt : acid ke ratio par depend karta hai.
Barabar salt aur acid: pH = pKa; acetate buffer ke liye 4.74.
